title: FedFST: Mitigating Spectral Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Graph Continual Learning

problem.claim: Dynamic task streams in federated graph continual learning cause catastrophic forgetting.

gap.claim: Existing methods do not explicitly address high-frequency inconsistency forgetting and low-frequency consistency forgetting.

contributions.claim: FedFST is a spectral-aware framework for mitigating dual spectral forgetting in federated graph continual learning.
FedFST uses Historical High-Frequency Knowledge Restoration to reconstruct and preserve high-frequency inconsistency knowledge.
FedFST uses Historical Low-Frequency Semantic Transfer with spectral distillation to stabilize low-frequency consistency.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that extensive experiments demonstrate FedFST's effectiveness in alleviating catastrophic forgetting in federated graph continual learning.
The authors report that code is available in a public GitHub repository.

narrative_sequence.summary: Federated graph continual learning faces catastrophic forgetting under dynamic task streams.
The forgetting is characterized spectrally as high-frequency inconsistency forgetting and low-frequency consistency forgetting.
Existing methods do not explicitly address both spectral failure modes.
FedFST combines high-frequency knowledge restoration with low-frequency semantic transfer through spectral distillation.
The authors report experimental effectiveness and provide code availability.

source_observation.claim: The abstract separates catastrophic forgetting into high-frequency inconsistency and low-frequency consistency problems.

interpretation.claim: A frequency-aware diagnosis can motivate separate mechanisms for preserving local discriminative information and global semantic coherence.

application.claim: Continual graph learning systems may benefit from treating distinct spectral components with specialized retention or transfer mechanisms.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this decomposition or the proposed mechanisms generalize beyond the reported federated graph continual learning setting.

unknowns: Datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, and experimental protocol are not specified.
Quantitative results and stage-by-stage retention or generalization outcomes are not reported.
The abstract does not provide implementation details for HHKR, HLST, or spectral distillation.
